The '''Triellus system''' was a part of the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] that began in the [[Centares system/Legends|Centares system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the neighboring [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]]<ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> and then passed through the Jospro [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="Triellus Jospro">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}} depicts a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] passing through the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] that ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' identifies as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]].</ref> before beginning its way along the eastern edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Triellus Trade Route existed at its complete length by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]<ref name="TEA" /> and was known by its name<ref name="Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref> by [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Lockdown date">{{InsiderCite|146|Blaster}} dates the events of ''[[Maul: Lockdown]]'', which include a mention of the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Triellus [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-7.<ref name="TEA" />
